description: Su-7 preserved at a roundabout/base memorial inside AFS Gwalior (warbirds.in unphotographed; Bharat Rakshak gives B-817, 221 Sqn 1971, "possibly", and separately lists B-802 as preserved at Gwalior). Identity uncertain between B817 and B802.
Canberra B(I)58 IF901 (c/n 71537, ex RAF XH230, ONUC 1962, 106 Sqn 2004) listed by Bharat Rakshak as preserved at Gwalior (identified from Google Earth). Single-source.
